world.introText: The Ancient Battlefield is a domain that was created by the Super Sects. This is the place were the Hundred Empire War will be fought. There is potent Nirvana Qi that even allows Manifestation Stage practitioner to be able to form Nirvana Pills from the Nirvana energy between Heaven and Earth.
world.history: The ancient battlefield was a space that had been left behind from an ancient time. It was said that countless years ago, an earth-shattering war had broke out on this land. The epic war was fought between entities that transcended even the super sects of the East Xuan Region today. It was described by many as world-shaking, earth-breaking and even space-shattering. The current size of the ancient battlefield was many folds smaller than it used to be at its peak, a result of the earth-shattering war. However, even though the ancient battlefield’s vastness had shrunken many fold, it was still much bigger than the Great Yan Empire by an unknown number of times.

world.introText: Dao Region is an extremely large mountain range controlled by the Dao Sect on of the eight Super Sects. Hundreds and thousands of empires dotted the area around this Dao Region. These empires viewed the Dao Sect as their leader and treated the Dao Sect as a holy land. They also relied on the Dao Sect to survive. Deep within this endlessly vast Dao Region mountain range, there was an area covered in mist that was clearly split off from everywhere else. Countless extremely tall and large mountains clustered together here. One could vaguely see an endless number of grand buildings on the top of these enormous mountains.

world.introText: The Demon Region/continent and the Chaotic Demon Sea were extremely far apart. Even a Profound Death Stage expert would have to fly for at least half a year in order to travel from one place to the other. Hence, a spatial teleportation array that covered such a great distance, was obviously not something that any ordinary faction could create.
world.history: The Six Finger Sage Dragon Emperor managed to unify the Demon Region. The Demonic Beast World was obviously even more chaotic during ancient times. Various warlords reigned over their territories, while many great overlord tribes occupied the land. The accumulated resources and foundations of these tribes were clearly not inferior to the Dragon Tribe. It was not a problem for the Dragon tribe to fight them as equals. However, it would definitely be wishful thinking to unify the Demonic Beast World and make these proud tribes submit.

world.introText: Demon Sound Mountain is situated at the deepest part of the Ten Thousand Beast Mountain Range. It was unusually steep and was covered with black trees known as sound tree. These trees were quite mysterious and they had the same effects as a loudspeaker and were able to magnify a sound to many times its original volume. Each and every moment, there would be a sharp sound being emitted from the entire mountain. Hence, this mountain was termed the Demon Sound Mountain.

Old hundred thousand feet tall trees stood like many small scale mountains. Their spreading leaves and branches enveloped the area within a ten thousand feet radius. A rich wilderness like aura surged across the land. It was one of the few areas within the Demon Region that had remained mostly unchanged since ancient times and was a land filled with all sorts of natural treasures.

world.introText: The Great Wastelands Ancient Tablet is the most famous object in the Great Desolate Province. It existed long before the Great Desolate Province. The Great Desolate Province was actually named after it. At that time, the strength of the ancient sect was truly terrifying. In fact, they directly opened up an extremely vast space inside the ancient tablet. Not only are there numerous relics within, the Yuan Power inside is also several times stronger than outside. If one trains there for one day, it will be as effective as training for ten days outside.
world.appearance:
A nearly one thousand meter long ancient stone tablet, as it silently stood at the deepest region of that vast plain. An boundless and vicissitude ancient aura emerged from it, allowing one to feel just how powerful that ancient sect was.

There were a few ancient and large symbols carved onto that ancient tablet, that were faintly discernible. A terrifying vibration, that seemed powerful enough to rip apart the heavens emerged from them. That vibration caused to understand just how tiny one was.

That ancient tablet stood right in the vast plains and it looked just like the stairways to heavens. It was harsh yet majestic, ancient yet vicissitude.

world.introText: Hidden Cave, also known as Rock Cave, is a secluded natural cave hidden beneath a steep cliff in the back mountain behind the Lin Family residence near Qingyang Town. It was accidentally discovered by Lin Dong and Qing Tan during their childhood and remained known only to the two of them. The cave housed the Rock Pool and concealed the mysterious Stone Talisman, the artifact that ultimately changed Lin Dong's cultivation journey.
world.appearance:
The cave is concealed behind several enormous boulders along a steep cliff, making its entrance extremely difficult to discover unless one is deliberately searching for it.

Inside, a narrow passage opens into a small natural chamber. At the center of the chamber lies the Rock Pool, a crystal-clear underground spring approximately six to ten meters wide. The cave remains naturally cool throughout the year, providing a refuge from the summer heat.

Hidden within a narrow crevice near the cave ceiling was the mysterious Stone Talisman. For an unknown period of time, the artifact continuously released tiny droplets of Red Liquid into the Rock Pool below, granting the pool its extraordinary cultivation-enhancing properties.
world.history:
Lin Dong and Qing Tan accidentally discovered the cave while exploring the back mountain during their childhood. Because of its secluded location, they kept its existence a secret and frequently visited it during the summer.

After learning the Penetrating Fist, Lin Dong returned to the cave to recover from his training injuries. Blood from his wounds accidentally dripped into the Rock Pool, triggering a reaction with the mysterious energy contained within the water. While investigating the source of this phenomenon, he discovered the Stone Talisman hidden in a crevice above the pool and took it away with him.

After the Stone Talisman was removed, the remaining Red Liquid within the Rock Pool was gradually exhausted after approximately ten days of use, causing the pool to lose its extraordinary body-tempering effect.

world.introText: The Mysterious Black Yin Mountain is a famous mountain range located in the Great Desolate Province. Home to the Ghastly Puppet Cult which build their Ghastly Puppet City on the top of the mountain. Throughout the year, a formidable bone-cutting cold enveloped this mountain range, hence ordinary people did not dare to stay here for too long, or else the cold qi would enter their bodies and freeze their blood. It was said that there was an even more terrible and renowned Mother Earth Mysterious Black Yin Crevice in the deepest part of the Mysterious Black Yin Mountain Range. No one knew how deep this Mysterious Black Yin Crevice was, and an extremely terrifying Cold Primal Wind gathered there. Within it, Cold Primal Wind attacked from all directions, resulting in the formation of countless Cold Primal Vortexes of various sizes. Once pulled into one, even a Manifestation Stage practitioner would be faced with certain death. Hence, the Mother Earth Mysterious Black Yin Crevice was undoubtedly a forbidden area within the Mysterious Black Yin Mountain Range.

world.introText: Rock Pool is a natural underground spring located within the Hidden Cave in the back mountain behind the Lin Family residence near Qingyang Town. Although it appeared to be an ordinary spring, the pool possessed remarkable cultivation-enhancing properties due to the influence of the hidden Stone Talisman, which continuously released tiny droplets of Red Liquid into its water. It was discovered during the childhood of Lin Dong and Qing Tan, and remained known only to the two of them until Lin Dong uncovered the Stone Talisman.
world.appearance:
The Rock Pool occupies the center of a small natural chamber inside the Secret Cave. The pool measures approximately six to ten meters across and contains exceptionally clear spring water that remains cool throughout the year.

Long before its true secret was discovered, Lin Dong frequently soaked in the pool after training because of its cool water. During these visits, he gradually noticed that the pool possessed an unusual ability to clear the mind, allowing him to concentrate more easily and improve the efficiency of his cultivation and martial arts practice.

The true nature of the Rock Pool was revealed after blood from Lin Dong's injuries accidentally dripped into the water. The spring immediately reacted as the hidden Red Liquid dispersed throughout the pool and entered his body through his pores, cleansing impurities and greatly enhancing the effectiveness of his body tempering.
world.history:
During their childhood, Lin Dong and Qing Tan accidentally discovered the Secret Cave while exploring the back mountain behind the Lin Family residence. Because of its hidden location, they kept its existence a secret and often visited it during the summer to escape the heat.

After learning the Penetrating Fist, Lin Dong returned to the Rock Pool to recover from his injuries. While resting in the water, blood from his wounds accidentally dripped into the pool, causing the water to turn red as the hidden Red Liquid reacted. The mysterious energy entered his body through his pores, expelled impurities, healed many of his injuries, and significantly accelerated his cultivation.

Suspecting that the phenomenon was not a coincidence, Lin Dong repeated the experiment by allowing fresh blood to enter the pool. After confirming the same reaction, he searched for the source of the mysterious energy and eventually discovered the Stone Talisman hidden within a crevice in the cave ceiling. He secretly removed the artifact and kept its existence hidden from everyone else.

Even after the Stone Talisman had been removed, the Rock Pool retained its enhanced properties for approximately ten more days because of the remaining Red Liquid dissolved in its water. Once that reserve was exhausted, Lin Dong periodically replenished the pool by adding fresh Red Liquid from the Stone Talisman whenever he wished to cultivate there.
world.trivia:
The Rock Pool was originally believed by Lin Dong to be nothing more than an unusually cold underground spring.

The pool's cultivation-enhancing properties originated entirely from the Stone Talisman hidden above it rather than the spring itself.

After the Stone Talisman was removed, the Rock Pool retained its extraordinary effects for only about ten days before the remaining Red Liquid was completely exhausted.

The Rock Pool was the place where Lin Dong first discovered the Stone Talisman, one of the most significant treasures in his cultivation journey.

world.introText: The Sky Flame Mountain is a mountain range located near Yan City and two other cities. The mountain range was extremely wide and it nearly traversed across half of Tiandu Province. In fact, it would not be an exaggeration to call it Tiandu province’s number one mountain range. Sky Flame Mountain Range was extremely wide and broad. Contained within were numerous vicious Demonic Beasts. In fact, it was said that if one ventured too deeply within, a single moment of carelessness would cause even an elite Creation stage practitioner to be in deep trouble. Therefore, usually, other than some professional Demonic Beast hunters, there was hardly anyone who ventured into Sky Flame Mountain Range.

world.introText: The Steel Wood Manor contains steel trees that grows on special dark soil and produces Steel Wood. This enterprise for the Lin Family would increase the profits for each year by approximately forty percent. Steel Wood was produced here in abundance and this type of Steel Wood was just like quality steel. It was resistant to both water and fire plus it was thick and strong, extremely suited for manufacturing weapons and construction purposes. Thus, this type of Steel Wood was relatively highly priced, combined with the fact that the Steel Wood Manor was the only source of Steel Wood within a 50 kilometer radius.
world.history:
A long time ago, the area where the Steel Wood Manor is presently located, was a volcano and all the dark soil came from when the volcano erupted. Now that the volcano has vanished, the dark soil is a limited commodity. 
It was a significant enterprise in the Lei Family.

world.introText: The Supreme Purity Celestial Pond / 太清仙池 is something left behind by a powerful practitioner from ancient times. It will only appear once every month.
world.history: The pond itself was formed from the remains of an ancient, immensely powerful practitioner. That individual’s bones suppressed the demonic corruption of the surrounding land for countless years, allowing the pond’s energy to remain pure despite its location within the Unique Devil Region. As a result, the pond is filled with an extraordinarily refined and mysterious energy that flows gently yet relentlessly into the body of anyone who enters it. This energy causes a brief piercing sensation at first contact, but it quickly becomes soothing, penetrating deep into the cultivator’s body.

world.history: Not long ago, a Half-Step Nirvana Stage practitioner, who is extremely adept at concealing himself, sneaked into the Thunder Granite Valley. At that time, they would become powerful enough to match up to a Nirvana Stage practitioner.

characters.title: Lin Dong
characters.introText: Lin Dong is the male protagonist of the Eastern fantasy novel Wu Dong Qian Kun written by Heavenly Silkworm Potato (Tiancan Tudou), as well as its derivative works. He also makes cameo appearances in The Great Ruler, The Heaven's List, Fights Break Sphere – Return of the Beasts, and Absolute Resonance.
characters.appearance:
Lin Dong has a resolute face, with a presence as deep and steady as an abyss and as imposing as a mountain. His aura is vast, calm, and restrained. He wears a purple-black long robe, standing with his hands behind his back, holding the Lightning Emperor Scepter in one hand. Lightning flickers across the scepter, and each flash of thunder carries the power to shake heaven and earth. Around him surges boundless spiritual energy, at times transforming into ice, at times into seas of fire, lightning, darkness, and more—profound and unfathomably wondrous.

Lin Dong has short, layered brown hair with uneven bangs and slightly spiked ends. He has red eyes, a narrow face, and light skin. His build is slim with a straight posture. He wears a dark brown jacket with a worn texture and metal buttons over a black shirt. The jacket has two chest pockets and visible seam lines. He wears dark pants with a belt, and a light-colored strap or cloth hangs from the waist area. His hands are uncovered, and he wears a simple bracelet on one wrist.

In the Donghua, Lin Dong has long black hair that reaches past his shoulders, worn loose with layered strands framing his face. He has sharp facial features, a straight nose, and light skin. His build is tall and muscular, with a broad chest and defined limbs. He wears a dark teal and black long coat with gold armor elements on the shoulders, forearms, waist, and boots. The coat is open at the chest, exposing his upper torso and a glowing blue marking or pattern across the chest and abdomen. The outfit includes fitted pants and armored boots with gold trim. Curved, blade-like gold ornaments extend from his forearms and shoulders.
characters.personality:
Lin Dong did not grow up in wealth or privilege. His strict father taught him the most important qualities in cultivation—perseverance and diligence—which became the only means by which he could compete with peers who possessed far better starting conditions. His father’s misfortune made Lin Dong extremely sensitive to the word “trash.” Witnessing his father’s decline caused Lin Dong to mature early; he became exceptionally serious and devoted to cultivation, yet he also understood that progress must be made step by step and never aimed unrealistically high.

Deep down, Lin Dong possesses an innate stubbornness and domineering resolve, with a level of determination and tenacity far exceeding that of his peers. His methods are ruthless—both toward his enemies and toward himself. His willpower, as immovable as a mountain, is one of the most crucial qualities in martial cultivation, and it is precisely this that allows him to pursue and surpass geniuses with greater natural talent.

He is decisive in character and shows no mercy to enemies, regardless of their gender or appearance. His will is unbreakable, capable of enduring the extreme agony of having his mind repeatedly shattered. Lin Dong believes that fairness must be seized by one’s own hands; he is a pragmatist who values usefulness above all else, caring little about the nature of the means so long as they work. If something benefits him, he does not mind doing things that others might consider disgraceful.

Understanding that debts of gratitude are the hardest to repay, Lin Dong dislikes owing too many favors. In dealing with others, if someone shows him an inch of respect, he returns a yard; if someone helps him, he will certainly repay it in kind. Conversely, to those who offend him, Lin Dong will never leave future trouble behind. However, toward enemies with shallow grudges and insufficient strength to truly threaten him, he will not kill them outright, instead extorting them by holding their lives as leverage.

He is calm and composed, neither arrogant nor impetuous, fearless in the face of adversity, believing that “only one who harbors no fear can be truly strong.” He knows when to yield and when to advance, and understands the value of stopping while ahead. Possessing genuine courage and boldness, Lin Dong can endure temporary humiliation when he is weak, refusing to act impulsively in ways that might endanger his family.

Although he understands patience and restraint, Lin Dong also has an extremely strong sense of self-respect. He can endure humiliation inflicted by Lin Langtian, yet finds it difficult to remain indifferent when scorn comes from a woman with whom he has shared physical intimacy. Lin Dong kneels only to heaven, earth, his father, and his mother—he will never bend his knees before anyone else. To lose his dignity in such a way is something he will absolutely never tolerate.

Lin Dong is a smart person who is kind to who he sees as friends. However he is ruthless towards the ones he sees as enemies.

He is not afraid to take risks and challenge strong opponents if they did him wrong.

Early in the series he was unskilled and was bullied a lot by Lin Shan. However he was diligent in his training and didn't lose faith when encountering a setback. He challenged Lin Shan multiple times just to see his progress.
characters.history:
Lin Dong is a member of the Lin family of the Great Yan Empire, belonging to an outer branch that lived in Qingyang Town. After his father was gravely injured by Lin Langtian, a prodigy of the Lin main clan, the mockery and ridicule from other juniors of the clan awakened Lin Dong’s intense desire for power. A mysterious stone talisman he happened to find in a mountain cave opened his path to becoming a powerhouse. With the help of Xiao Diao, the spirit within the talisman, Lin Dong rose to become the strongest of the younger generation in the Great Yan Empire.

Relying on unwavering faith and an unyielding character, Lin Dong achieved tremendous breakthroughs and glorious accomplishments through constant perseverance and effort. During the great war against the Yimo Clan, the Ice Master burned her cycle of reincarnation to help Lin Dong step into the Ancestor Stage, where he slew the Yimo Emperor and saved the entire Tianxuan Continent. From that point on, Lin Dong was revered by the world as the “Martial Ancestor”.

characters.title: Ling Qingzhu
characters.introText: Ling Qingzhu is the Young Palace Mistress of the Nine Heavens Supreme Purity Palace, a super sect of the Eastern Xuan Region. In the ancient tomb mansion of the Sky Flame Mountain Range within the Great Yan Empire, she unexpectedly became involved with Lin Dong, and later, as Lin Dong persistently pursued her, she gradually fell in love with him. When Yuan Gate launched an assault on the Nine Heavens Supreme Purity Palace, she was appointed at a critical moment to succeed as the Palace Master.
characters.appearance:
She wore a light-coloured silk dress, with eyebrows like jade feathers and flesh as white as snow. Her waist was gorgeously small while a veil covered her face, only revealing her clear eyes which seemed to flow like water as the world seemed to lose colour before her beauty.

Barefoot upon lotus blossoms, dressed in a light-colored plain gown, brows like emerald feathers, skin like white snow, a slender waist like bound silk—behind the thin veil covering her face, her clear eyes glance about, dimming heaven and earth by their presence. Her voice is light and ethereal, and within those crystal-clear eyes lies a deeply ingrained aloofness that keeps others at a distance. (Martial Universe)

The woman wears a white dress; her slender figure is graceful, and though a light veil covers her face, it cannot conceal her exquisite contours. Smooth black hair falls down, jade-like hands holding a cyan longsword. Her cold, pristine aura is like that of a moon palace goddess. (The Great Ruler)
characters.personality:
Qingzhu appears warm on the outside but cold within. She seems gentle, polite, and even soft-spoken, giving the impression of being easy to get along with, yet in truth her heart is like profound ice, and when she acts, she shows no mercy. She has a cool temperament and dislikes contention. Like a lotus flower, she is reserved, concealing everything deep within her cold inner world, unreachable by others. She never reveals her thoughts or emotions, savoring them alone, and only those close to her can sense the burning passion wrapped within that cold exterior.

She is proud and aloof, carrying an invisible disdain toward others. Having seen countless young geniuses, few can enter her eyes or stir her heart in the slightest. She is a phoenix soaring through the heavens—seemingly cold, yet filled with arrogance in her bones—and she would never stop her steps or nestle beside an immature wolf still striving toward strength simply because of a chance encounter.
characters.history:
Ling Qingzhu is the direct disciple of the Palace Master of the Nine Heavens Supreme Purity Palace, a super sect of the Eastern Xuan Region, and holds an extraordinary status. Her beauty is also exceedingly rare in the world; countless geniuses and elites from super sects admire her, yet no one has ever been able to lift that thin veil and glimpse her stunning face beneath. Entrusted by Huangpu Jing of the Great Yan Empire, Qingzhu went to the Sky Flame Mountain Range to explore an ancient tomb of a fallen Nirvana Realm cultivator, where she unexpectedly had sex with Lin Dong. Lin Dong thus became the first man to see Qingzhu’s true appearance and the first to possess her body.

She met Lin Dong during a Nirvana Tomb mission and lost her virginity to him. This eventually led to Lin Dong becoming strong in pursuit of chasing after her. She abandoned the Yuan Power cultivation system and the Mental Energy cultivation system for Zenith Power.She got this Zenith Power from her master while she was dying and their Nine Heavens Supreme Purity Palace was being attacked by Yimo and people from Yuan Gate. She had a very good talent which is proved by the fact that she was able to get Zenith Power from master even though the chance were very low.

characters.title: Ying Huanhuan
characters.introText: It was later revealed that she is the reincarnation of the Ice Master, one of the Ancient Masters and the most outstanding among them. She did not originate from the Tianxuan Continent.
characters.appearance:
With black and lovely eyes and curly ponytail she look extremely lovely and cute.

As her reincarnated soul awakens, her eyes become ice blue along with her hair when she started forming her initial Yuan spirit. During the Great Sect Competition, her black eyes started to merge with the ice blue indicating a merge of souls.
characters.trivia: In the sequel novel The Great Ruler, she helps him manage the Martial Realm in the Great Thousand Worlds and currently serves as the clan head of the Ice Spirit Clan.

characters.personality: He is a rather Prideful/arrogant character, insisting on being referred to as Grandpa Marten, referring to his being their elder as such their better. At the same time he is caring of those he considers friend, such has his constant support of Lin Dong and Little Flame. He's also rather lazy.
characters.history:
He used to be the previous owner of the Stone Talisman. Not long after he obtained this thing, he was pursued. In the end, he was forced to self-destruct, his Demon Spirit escaping into the Stone Talisman as the final resort.

He once encountered a powerful practitioner wanting to get the approval of the Flame Ancestral Symbol. However, eventually, he was burnt into crisp by that Thousand Heavenly Flames that was invoked by the Flame Ancestral Symbol.

A hundred years ago, not a single person from the younger generation could match up to the latter. Even Hao Jiuyou, who was now the most outstanding younger generation member, was merely the latter’s lackey at that time. Unfortunately… a hundred years had allowed those behind him to catch up.

He was the most outstanding talent in the Celestial Demon Marten tribe a hundred years ago. At that time Hao Jiuyou was a follower of his. He would come to the aid of Hao Jiuyou when he was being bullied, however Hao Jiuyou betrayed him by passing on the information of him travelling outside of the demon city to some Yimo.
characters.trivia: Named Lin Diao by Lin Dong once he took his human form.

characters.personality: Very lively and talkative girl. Honest to the point of irritating, in little marten's point of view.

characters.quotes: "The life of one, begins and ends alone. Full of kindnesses and hatreds, but will not reach the hundreds. What's the purpose of life? Your own decision, Your own enlightenment"

characters.title: Bo Xuan
characters.introText: Bo Xuan is the Palace Master of the Palace of Darkness, and the master of Lin Qingtan and Chen Kui. He is depicted as a gaunt old man dressed in black robes, wearing a black crown, with a hoarse voice. His cultivation reached the peak of the Samsara Realm, and he once wielded the Darkness Ancestral Symbol and the Darkness Saint Scythe.
characters.appearance:
In the novel, Bo Xuan is a gaunt old man wearing black robes and a black crown, with a hoarse voice.

He has light skin and a tall, broad build. He has long silver hair pulled back, with loose strands flowing behind him. His eyebrows are thick and dark gray. He has deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and a long mustache with a pointed beard, both white. His face shows visible age lines around the eyes and forehead.

He wears layered robes in black, dark red, and gold. The outfit includes ornate gold armor pieces on the shoulders and chest. A large black feathered mantle extends from his shoulders.

characters.history:
A senior of the Palace of Darkness discovered the exceptionally talented Qing Tan in the Great Yan Empire. After the Hundred Empire War began, Lin Qingtan followed that senior to the Palace of Darkness. After she joined, she was taken as a disciple by Bo Xuan. (In Manhua, it’s the Female-Bo Xuan who found her.)

When the three Lin brothers were forced by the [[Yuan Gate]], Lin Qingtan came to assist them. After Lin Dong escaped, Shi Dong of the Yuan Gate attempted to seize Lin Qingtan, but Bo Xuan appeared in time to stop him. Afterwards, Lin Qingtan agreed to inherit Bo Xuan’s legacy and entered the Dark Tribunal.

Several years later, Bo Xuan died after failing to break through to the Reincarnation Stage. Before his death, he passed his inheritance and the Darkness Ancestral Symbol to Lin Qingtan.

characters.title: Fifth Seat King
characters.introText: Fifth Seat King is a Yimo a peak expert who had experienced three Reincarnation Tribulations.
characters.appearance: The Fifth Seat King is a Yimo expert whose form is humanoid. He wears dark attire that were consistent with high-ranking Devil Prison figures.
characters.personality: The Fifth Seat King is calm, calculating, and confident. He speaks in a relaxed, almost casual manner even when facing ancient masters like the Thunderbolt Master, showing no panic or agitation. He is pragmatic rather than hot-blooded: his priority is achieving objectives, such as rescuing the Seventh Seat King, rather than engaging in unnecessary prolonged combat.
characters.history:
The Thunderbolt Master is on the verge of completely annihilating the Seventh Seat King. After being utterly outmatched—his escape techniques shattered one by one, his true body forced out, and his Demonic Qi crushed under a massive lightning seal—the Seventh Seat King is seconds away from death. At that critical moment, space itself is violently torn apart behind him, opening a vast spatial rift. From within it, an enormous devil hand extends and forcibly intercepts the Thunderbolt Master’s lightning seal, stopping the killing blow and flinging the attack away with overwhelming strength.

Standing calmly atop the devil hand is a new figure: the Fifth Seat King. Unlike the Seventh Seat King’s desperation, the Fifth Seat King appears relaxed and confident, greeting the Thunderbolt Master with mocking familiarity, as if their meeting were long overdue rather than a life-or-death confrontation.

The Fifth Seat King makes his intentions clear. He has not come to fight, but to extract the Seventh Seat King. He openly states that while the Thunderbolt Master is powerful, there is no need for him to waste strength trying to stop this rescue.

Before leaving, the Fifth Seat King briefly turns his attention to Lin Dong. He directly acknowledges him, expressing mild surprise and amusement that Lin Dong was able to push the Seventh Seat King into such a miserable state. With a casual wave of his sleeve, Demonic Qi engulfs the battered Seventh Seat King, and the spatial crack opens once more, swallowing both the Fifth and the Seventh Seat King as they retreat cleanly from the battlefield.

The Thunderbolt Master launches a massive lightning attack, forming a colossal lightning lion that charges toward the retreating figure. The Fifth Seat King calmly counters by summoning an enormous devil lotus, which blocks the attack without difficulty. Laughing, he taunts the Thunderbolt Master one last time, declaring that the Yimo will overturn the outcome of the ancient war, before disappearing completely into the collapsing spatial rift.

Later on, the Fifth Seat King makes his second entrance after the Cosmic Evil Devil King has successfully broken free.

When the sea below Martial Gathering Island erupts and the enormous, heavily wounded Cosmic Evil Devil King emerges into the sky, two figures are revealed standing calmly upon its massive body. One of them is the Fifth Seat King.

Together with the Fourth Seat King, the Fifth Seat King openly greets Ying Huanhuan, addressing her as the Ice Master and acknowledging their reunion after tens of thousands of years.

When questioned by the Spatial Master, the Fifth Seat King casually admits that rescuing the Cosmic Evil Devil King required immense effort, particularly due to interference from the Flame Master.

characters.title: Lin Jing
characters.introText: Lin Jing is the daughter of Lin Dong and Ling Qingzhu.
characters.personality: She is a kind of lively yet careless girl. Although she possess huge potential and on several occasions showed her peerless strength among the young generation, her adventurous nature hamper her from truly reaching the peak in the manner Mu Chen does.
characters.history:
Mu Chen first met Lin Jing in Merchant City as he went there for an auction to find materials he need to cultivate his Sovereign Celestial Body. Lin Jing apparently has run away from home and forgot to bring some sovereign liquids (a currency), and Mu Chen had to bailed her out from an angry merchant whose a hundred years sovereign fruit got eaten by her.

Later on, they met again in the auction house. Mu Chen would help her to get away from Liu Ming, young master of Sky Profound Palace. He would also help her to get Heavenly Flame Jade Chalcedony she needed for her Sovereign Celestial Body, and she gave him a protective artifact, Defensive Spiritual Jade, to thank him. She would later join Mu Chen to fight against Liu Ming and his people as they tried to steal Mu Chen's Void Great Solar Fruit he won from the auction, which was actually a trap as Mu Chen intend to obtain Liu Ming's Undying Divine Leaf.

When Mu Chen seemingly was able to suppress Liu Ming, Demonic Human Elder of Sky Profound Palace appear and tried to kill both Lin Jing and Mu Chen in revenge. However, before he could do so, Lin Jing's mother, Ling Qingzhu, appeared and suppressed him instead together with the group from Sky Profound Palace.

When Qingzhu made clear that she must go home, Lin Jing invited Mu Chen to Martial Realm to come along with her, but he rejected as he thought he cannot truly grow his strength if he had such a powerful faction protecting him.

Lin Jing was not very pleased by Mu Chen's rejection, but had to accepted Mu Chen's decision while quietly scolded his decision making.

characters.introText:
Lin Xiao
is the father of the main protagonist of Wu Dong Qian Kun. Once regarded the most outstanding genius of the Lin Family. He is the 3rd son of Lin Zhentian.
characters.personality: Once prideful outstanding genius of the Lin Family. After being crippled he felt unworthy. Even sick he went into the dangerous mountains in order to get resources to aid his son in his cultivation.
characters.history:
Lin Xiao was the earliest to break trough 9th layer of Tempered Body, and advance into the Earthly Yuan Stage. Furthermore, in another short four years, he once again broke through the Yuan stage to become the 2nd Heavenly Yuan master in the Lin Family after Lin Zhentian. Because of this he became the most gifted and remarkable man in Qingyang Town.

He participated in the Ten-Year Clan Gathering of the Lin Clan. However he lost in the first round in one move by Lin Langtian. After his defeat the latter without mercy used his Yuan force to ravage the insides of Lin Xiao body. This crippled him and lost his Heavenly Yuan Stage of strength en returned to Earthly Yuan Stage. His channels in his body are disrupted and clogged up. Further advancements were made impossible. Low Level elixirs are useless to him. After the gathering the family fell in deep despair.
After this event he left the inner district of Lin Family and moved to live in a small desolate hill at the furthest reaches of the Lin Family territory. he no longer used any resources of the family as he no longer believes he has the right to do so. This decreased his wealth.

He taught his son that the most important things for training were willpower and diligence. This is the only advantage over his peers who were blessed with wealth.

It took nearly a month of training before he could make 4 echo's with the Penetrating Fist. It took 1 month more training in order to produce up to 6 echo's from the Penetrating Fist.

Lin Hong asked Lin Xiao to be engaged to Qing Tan. This request had been flatly rejected by Lin Xiao. This matter had further deepened the enmity between both parties.

Qing Tan frequently collapses and emits chilling cold. Lin Xiao could not find any solution to alleviate her condition. He once tried to use Yuan Force to forcefully expel the chilling cold, but in the end, he had to spend nearly half a month in bed in order to remove the chilling cold that entered his body.

In the past the Yin Energy Lin Xiao absorbed was merely of Grade 3.

"Only during this time, will one be able to break through his limits".
To Lin Dong regarding training.

characters.introText: Fiery-red tiger python cub. As a tiger python, its tail resembles a fire python. Little Flame is also a unique variation of fire python cub, as it possesses a transforming physique, allowing its appearance to change upon consuming other unique beasts. His initial appearance changed after eating a Demonic Crystal. The originally fiery-red fur had now become even fierier and vibrant. It looked as if it was burning. characters.appearance:
Fiery-red tiger python cub. As a tiger python, its tail resembles a fire python. Little Flame is also a unique variation of fire python cub, as it possesses a transforming physique, allowing its appearance to change upon consuming other unique beasts. His initial appearance changed after eating a Demonic Crystal. The originally fiery-red fur had now become even fierier and vibrant. It looked as if it was burning. Furthermore, its tiger paws now seem exceptionally sharp as they penetrated deep into the ground. Currently, the unique python tail was perched on Little Flame’s back. There seemed to be a small lump on the head of that python tail as if something was about to burst out.

When in human form Little Flame resembles a fairly muscular and towering man. With metallic black skin which made him look exactly like a steel tower.  His tall and powerful body had a strong deterring effect. His face looked pretty dull. However, upon closer inspection, one would realize that this face actually vaguely resembled Lin Dong.

In tiger form, he has pitch-black, ink like fur with a metallic lustre, humongous, sharp, black wings which seem to flicker with an icy cold glint that was as sharp as the edge of a blade.
characters.personality: Little Flame is described as attacking with a ferociousness that belies his bestial nature. Towering and imposing, his resoluteness and dominance is second only to Lin Dong and Lin Diao (Little Marten). He is absolutely obedient to Lin Dong and resolutely respects Lin Diao; considering them his first and second brothers. Despite this aggressive nature, when interacting with those which have gained his trust, or are considered family, such as Qin Tan, he is gentle, much like a puppy.
characters.history: Lin Yan was born in a triplet Fire Python Tiger litter.
characters.trivia:
Once reached the Form Creation Stage, Little Flame was now able to control his body size and change it, becoming an arm held small scarlet red beast for convenience.

Little Flame (One Yuan) fuses with the Heavenly Demonic Tiger’s bones and is able to attain human form.

Named Lin Yan by Lin Dong once he took his human form.

Little Marten always mocking and bickering with Little Flame, he even just called it stupid little tiger. But actually they really care for each other. Whenever had a chance, Little Marten always suggesting a way to make Little Flame more powerful and progressing its cultivation.

Qing Tan has a long silver-white hair that flows past her waist, with loose strands and a side tuft tied by a small accessory. She has large orange eyes, a small nose, and light skin. Her build is slim with long legs. She wears a sleeveless blue cheongsam-style dress with gold trim and side slits. The dress is decorated with ornamental knots and multicolored tassels at the waist and shoulders. She wears black thigh-high stockings with blue edging and flat shoes. Beaded accessories and tassels are attached to her outfit, and her arms are bare.

In the Donghua, Qing Tan is shown to have a fair skin and long light-silver hair styled in twin ponytails tied with blue ribbons. Her bangs cover her forehead, and her hair falls over both shoulders. Her eyes appear large and dark, and she is wearing light makeup with red lipstick.

She is often seen wearing a sleeveless blue dress with a high collar and a keyhole opening at the chest. The dress has decorative patterns and a large bow at the waist. Detached blue sleeves cover her forearms. The skirt is short in the front and longer in the back, forming a trailing layer behind her legs.
characters.personality: She's a cheerfull and bright girl who really love her adopted family, she's also romantically in love with her adopted brother, Lin Dong.
characters.history:
Qing Tan along with Lin Dong found the Secret Cave in their younger days.

Qing Tan is an orphan and was adopted by Liu Yan not long after Lin Dong was born. Her name was given by Liu Yan. She was searching for elixirs to aid Lin Dong in his training. Then an accident happened and she injured herself. Lin Xiao forbade her to venture into the woods.

She once was afraid that training would make you ugly. Therefor she never trained.

Qing Tan frequently collapses and emits chilling cold. When this happens her hair glittering with ice crystals. This happened since young. Over these past ten years, she has suffered immensely due to this chilling cold. Under the effects of this chill, her insides will be tormented by extreme pain. Lin Xiao could not find any solution to alleviate her condition. He once tried to use Yuan Force to forcefully expel the chilling cold, but in the end, he had to spend nearly half a month in bed in order to remove the chilling cold that entered his body.

characters.introText: Symbol Ancestor  (also known as Fu Zu) was the owner of all the 8 Ancestral Symbols. He was a legendary dictator. A legendary expert who ruled over the world. He only needed to flick his finger if he wished to destroy the entire Great Yan Empire.
characters.history:
More than hundred thousand years ago there was a Symbol Ancestor. The last Symbol Ancestor was a legendary dictator. A legendary expert who ruled over the world. He is the saviour of this world. If it was not because he ignited his reincarnation and used his life to seal the crack between the worlds, that great world war might have continued for countless years.

Lord Symbol Ancestor died and the eight ancient masters were seriously injured and on the verge of death. Before Lord Symbol Ancestor died, he used his last bit of power to deliver the Ice Master into reincarnation. However, his remaining strength was no longer sufficient to support the others into reincarnation.

In the past the Nine Heavens Supreme Purity Palace was called Zenith Palace. The Symbol Ancestor was a member of the Zenith Palace. The Symbol Ancestor was not the founder but the name originated from him. Even the Nine Heavens Supreme Purity Palace do not know whether the so-called Zenith Palace is a sect or whether it represents an even greater secret.

The legendary Symbol Ancestor did not come from this World. He came from the same place as the Yimo Emperor. They came here for the same reason. The Dimension Fetus.

We learn in The Great Ruler that the Symbol Ancestor was in fact an expert from the Great Thousand World

characters.introText: Zhu Tianhuo is a member of the Great Gan Empire.
characters.appearance: His hair was completely fiery red, appearing just like a cluster of fiercely burning flames.

characters.title: Zi Yue

infobox.Younger Generation: Zi Yue
infobox.Members: Cao Zhu, Zhou Tong, Liu Long, Zi Yue, Li Hu

characters.introText: Zi Yue lives in Yan City and is the Yan City governor’s daughter.
characters.appearance: She is tall and slender, wearing a violet dress. Her skin was like snow while her eyebrows were fine and shapely. 	An oval face, a small cherry-red mouth and delicate features all came together to create an extremely beautiful woman. However, that frigid yet pretty face clearly told others that no one should get close.
characters.personality: Zi Yue has a tough personality and can be selfish sometimes.
characters.history: Zi Yue is one of Master Yan's students.

cultivation.title: Symbol Master

infobox.Titles: Symbol Master, Symbol Ancestor, Super Sect, Ancient Masters

cultivation.introText: Seal Masters (符师) were practitioners who utilize a different method of exerting Yuan Power. This method needed Mental Energy to propel Yuan Power. A Symbol Master could condense Yuan Power from Heaven and Earth into special Mystical Symbols. One not only needed a certain level of strength in the physical body as support but it also placed a heavy and strict demand on one’s mental capacity. In order to become a 1st Seal Symbol Master one is required to be at least Earthly Yuan Early Stage Therefore, Symbol Master was considered a scarce vocation. A 2nd Seal Symbol Master would be lavishly welcomed by any major faction in Yan City. Symbol Masters are split by Seals and there were a total of 5 Seals: 1st Seal being the lowest, while 5th Seal being the highest.
cultivation.appearance:
Equivalent to Heavenly Yuan Stage. In order to become a 1st stage symbol master, you are required to be at least Earthly Yuan Early Stage.

Equivalent to Initial Yuan Dan Stage. A 2nd Seal Symbol Master is unable to fully materialize Mental Energy.

Equivalent to Advanced Yuan Dan Stage.

Equivalent to Perfect Yuan Dan Stage.

The fifth talisman was condensed. The natal talisman had spirituality and could be used to forge spiritual treasures(灵宝) and condense spiritual fire(精神之火). One thought could move mountains and seas. When fighting with others, even a mountain could be forcibly moved with a thought. His use of mental power was relatively superficial.

Equivalent to Form Creation, Qi Creation & Manifestation Stages

Low Tier Equivalent to Form Creation Stage

Middle Tier Equivalent to Qi Creation Stage

High Tier Equivalent to Manifestation Stage

Equivalent to Nirvana Stage.

When a practitioner becomes a Heaven Symbol Master they form a tiny world within their Niwan Palace.

There are nine seals for the Heaven Symbol Master stage, which is identical to the nine Yuan Nirvana stages. At every advancement, the tiny world in your Niwan Palace will become more and more perfect. When a practitioner first advances to the Heaven Symbol Master Stage they will start creating their first seal.

They are able to condense Mental Energy into miraculous Symbols and move the power of the land with a single gesture. They possessed great power and even a Nirvana stage practitioner would find a Heaven Symbol Master a rather troublesome opponent.

The Divine Symbol Master level, is divided into Initial and Advance, but is this trivial two ranks, actually sufficiently compares favorably with fresh Profound Life Stage and Profound Death Stage, in general, Mental Energy achieves Peak Initial Divine Symbol Master, then endures powerhouse that Profound Life Stage is more Perfect, if steps into Advance Divine Symbol Master, that then can be a worthy opponent with Profound Death Stage powerhouse.

Equivalent to Profound Life Stage
Initial: Initial to Peak

Equivalent to Profound Death Stage
Advance: Initial to Peak

This was a watershed level for the Symbol Masters. There were many people in this world who trained their Mental Energy. Similarly, there were many people who trained both their Mental Energy and Yuan Power simultaneously. However, there were very few practitioners whose Mental Energy cultivation could reach the Symbol Grandmaster level.

Mental Energy was undoubtedly even more ethereal compared to Yuan Power. Therefore, trying to reach the level of Symbol Grandmaster was evidently no easy task. Before reaching the Symbol Grandmaster level, the strength of one’s Mental Energy might be a little weaker compared to the powerful and majestic Yuan Power. However, upon stepping into this level, the true might of Mental Energy would be slowly revealed.

Equivalent to Samsara Stage
Initial

Equivalent to Reincarnation Stage
Advance

Equivalent to 3rd Layer Reincarnation Tribulation.

Since the beginning of time, the number of people who managed to reach this level could be counted on one hand.

In order to obtain this rank, you need to destroy your Niwan Palace and then recreate it. If you fail you lose your Mental Energy and possibly even your sanity.

Once the divine palace is built so that it can contain Mental Enegia, it must be activated using Zenith Energy otherwise it will not work, during this process the Mental Energy will go through a metamorphosis merging with Zentih energy this is an incredibly lake process (Lin Dong late more than a whole year to complete the process even being in a place where the time passes different from the outside)

The Mental energy after entering this level is infinite and is interspersed with the brightness of the light of the primordial chaos of the Zenith energy making it more powerful than the normal Mental energy, allowing also to easily manipulate the Zenith energy.

When entering at this level, people will not be able to perceive their level of either the Yuan energy, nor the Mental energy.

The Divine Symbol Master level, is divided into Initial and Advance, but is this trivial two ranks, actually sufficiently compares favorably with fresh Profound Life Stage and Profound Death Stage, in general, Mental Energy achieves Peak Initial Divine Symbol Master, then endures powerhouse that Profound Life Stage is more Perfect, if steps into Advance Divine Symbol Master, that then can be a worthy opponent with Profound Death Stage powerhouse.

cultivation.introText: Earthly Yuan Stage is the second stage of cultivation. This is the first major checkpoint in the path of training. After advancing to Earthly Yuan Stage, the most vital step was to absorb Yin Energy, that existed between Heaven and Earth, into one’s body. After which, the Yin Energy will merge with the Yuan Power that lies in one’s body, greatly enhancing the attacking potential of one’s Yuan Power. It is recommended to be at least this Stage in order to learn Level 3 Martial Arts. Once you enter this stage you can learn Secret Arts.

cultivation.title: Symbol Master

infobox.Titles: Symbol Master, Symbol Ancestor, Super Sect, Ancient Masters

cultivation.introText: Seal Masters (符师) were practitioners who utilize a different method of exerting Yuan Power. This method needed Mental Energy to propel Yuan Power. A Symbol Master could condense Yuan Power from Heaven and Earth into special Mystical Symbols. One not only needed a certain level of strength in the physical body as support but it also placed a heavy and strict demand on one’s mental capacity. In order to become a 1st Seal Symbol Master one is required to be at least Earthly Yuan Early Stage Therefore, Symbol Master was considered a scarce vocation. A 2nd Seal Symbol Master would be lavishly welcomed by any major faction in Yan City. Symbol Masters are split by Seals and there were a total of 5 Seals: 1st Seal being the lowest, while 5th Seal being the highest.
cultivation.appearance:
Equivalent to Heavenly Yuan Stage. In order to become a 1st stage symbol master, you are required to be at least Earthly Yuan Early Stage.

Equivalent to Initial Yuan Dan Stage. A 2nd Seal Symbol Master is unable to fully materialize Mental Energy.

Equivalent to Advanced Yuan Dan Stage.

Equivalent to Perfect Yuan Dan Stage.

The fifth talisman was condensed. The natal talisman had spirituality and could be used to forge spiritual treasures(灵宝) and condense spiritual fire(精神之火). One thought could move mountains and seas. When fighting with others, even a mountain could be forcibly moved with a thought. His use of mental power was relatively superficial.

Equivalent to Form Creation, Qi Creation & Manifestation Stages

Low Tier Equivalent to Form Creation Stage

Middle Tier Equivalent to Qi Creation Stage

High Tier Equivalent to Manifestation Stage

Equivalent to Nirvana Stage.

When a practitioner becomes a Heaven Symbol Master they form a tiny world within their Niwan Palace.

There are nine seals for the Heaven Symbol Master stage, which is identical to the nine Yuan Nirvana stages. At every advancement, the tiny world in your Niwan Palace will become more and more perfect. When a practitioner first advances to the Heaven Symbol Master Stage they will start creating their first seal.

They are able to condense Mental Energy into miraculous Symbols and move the power of the land with a single gesture. They possessed great power and even a Nirvana stage practitioner would find a Heaven Symbol Master a rather troublesome opponent.

The Divine Symbol Master level, is divided into Initial and Advance, but is this trivial two ranks, actually sufficiently compares favorably with fresh Profound Life Stage and Profound Death Stage, in general, Mental Energy achieves Peak Initial Divine Symbol Master, then endures powerhouse that Profound Life Stage is more Perfect, if steps into Advance Divine Symbol Master, that then can be a worthy opponent with Profound Death Stage powerhouse.

Equivalent to Profound Life Stage
Initial: Initial to Peak

Equivalent to Profound Death Stage
Advance: Initial to Peak

This was a watershed level for the Symbol Masters. There were many people in this world who trained their Mental Energy. Similarly, there were many people who trained both their Mental Energy and Yuan Power simultaneously. However, there were very few practitioners whose Mental Energy cultivation could reach the Symbol Grandmaster level.

Mental Energy was undoubtedly even more ethereal compared to Yuan Power. Therefore, trying to reach the level of Symbol Grandmaster was evidently no easy task. Before reaching the Symbol Grandmaster level, the strength of one’s Mental Energy might be a little weaker compared to the powerful and majestic Yuan Power. However, upon stepping into this level, the true might of Mental Energy would be slowly revealed.

Equivalent to Samsara Stage
Initial

Equivalent to Reincarnation Stage
Advance

Equivalent to 3rd Layer Reincarnation Tribulation.

Since the beginning of time, the number of people who managed to reach this level could be counted on one hand.

In order to obtain this rank, you need to destroy your Niwan Palace and then recreate it. If you fail you lose your Mental Energy and possibly even your sanity.

Once the divine palace is built so that it can contain Mental Enegia, it must be activated using Zenith Energy otherwise it will not work, during this process the Mental Energy will go through a metamorphosis merging with Zentih energy this is an incredibly lake process (Lin Dong late more than a whole year to complete the process even being in a place where the time passes different from the outside)

The Mental energy after entering this level is infinite and is interspersed with the brightness of the light of the primordial chaos of the Zenith energy making it more powerful than the normal Mental energy, allowing also to easily manipulate the Zenith energy.

When entering at this level, people will not be able to perceive their level of either the Yuan energy, nor the Mental energy.

This was a watershed level for the Symbol Masters. There were many people in this world who trained their Mental Energy. Similarly, there were many people who trained both their Mental Energy and Yuan Power simultaneously. However, there were very few practitioners whose Mental Energy cultivation could reach the Symbol Grandmaster level.

Mental Energy was undoubtedly even more ethereal compared to Yuan Power. Therefore, trying to reach the level of Symbol Grandmaster was evidently no easy task. Before reaching the Symbol Grandmaster level, the strength of one’s Mental Energy might be a little weaker compared to the powerful and majestic Yuan Power. However, upon stepping into this level, the true might of Mental Energy would be slowly revealed.

Initial

Equivalent to Reincarnation Stage
Advance

Equivalent to 3rd Layer Reincarnation Tribulation.

Since the beginning of time, the number of people who managed to reach this level could be counted on one hand.

In order to obtain this rank, you need to destroy your Niwan Palace and then recreate it. If you fail you lose your Mental Energy and possibly even your sanity.

Once the divine palace is built so that it can contain Mental Enegia, it must be activated using Zenith Energy otherwise it will not work, during this process the Mental Energy will go through a metamorphosis merging with Zentih energy this is an incredibly lake process (Lin Dong late more than a whole year to complete the process even being in a place where the time passes different from the outside)

The Mental energy after entering this level is infinite and is interspersed with the brightness of the light of the primordial chaos of the Zenith energy making it more powerful than the normal Mental energy, allowing also to easily manipulate the Zenith energy.

When entering at this level, people will not be able to perceive their level of either the Yuan energy, nor the Mental energy.

cultivation.introText: Seal Masters (符师) were practitioners who utilize a different method of exerting Yuan Power. This method needed Mental Energy to propel Yuan Power. A Symbol Master could condense Yuan Power from Heaven and Earth into special Mystical Symbols. One not only needed a certain level of strength in the physical body as support but it also placed a heavy and strict demand on one’s mental capacity. In order to become a 1st Seal Symbol Master one is required to be at least Earthly Yuan Early Stage Therefore, Symbol Master was considered a scarce vocation. A 2nd Seal Symbol Master would be lavishly welcomed by any major faction in Yan City. Symbol Masters are split by Seals and there were a total of 5 Seals: 1st Seal being the lowest, while 5th Seal being the highest.

cultivation.introText: Yuan Dan Stage is the 4th stage of cultivation and marks the last stage of the Yuan Stage. The Yuan Dan stage consists of nine different ranks, termed as the Nine Stars of Yuan Dan. A One Star Yuan Dan is the lowest Stage, whereas a Nine Star Yuan Dan is the highest. When reaching this stage one is able to refine Yang Yuan Pills. Powerful factions are able to use Symbol Arrays as a catalyst to lower the requirements, though the Yang Yuan Pills created would be at a lower grade. Perfect Yuan Stage practitioners can spit out their Yuan Dan. However most would choose to never do it. One can loose an arm, but not their Yuan Dan.

artifacts.title: Stone Talisman
artifacts.introText: Stone Talisman, later revealed to be the Ancestral Stone (祖石), is an ancient divine artifact created by the Symbol Ancestor during the Ancient War against the Yimo. Hidden within the Hidden Cave above the Rock Pool for countless years, it was eventually discovered by Lin Dong, becoming the cornerstone of his cultivation journey.
artifacts.appearance:
When first discovered, the Stone Talisman appeared as a small ash-gray stone artifact approximately two fingers wide. Its surface was covered with mysterious ancient symbols resembling cryptic characters.

The artifact was embedded within a perfectly preserved palm imprint hidden inside a narrow crevice near the ceiling of the Hidden Cave. Despite the passage of countless years, the palm imprint remained exceptionally clear, suggesting that an unimaginably powerful individual had placed the artifact there.

Before its true identity was revealed, the Stone Talisman occasionally emitted a faint glow while continuously absorbing moonlight from its surroundings.

As the Ancestral Stone gradually recovered its power, more of its ancient runes became visible whenever it was activated. Following Yan's gradual awakening, more of the artifact's true nature and abilities were revealed.
artifacts.personality:
During the Ancient War, the Symbol Ancestor created the Ancestral Stone to aid in the war against the Yimo and to maintain the balance among the Eight Ancestral Symbols.

Throughout the conflict, he wielded the artifact alongside the Eight Ancestral Symbols. The Ancestral Stone played a vital role in suppressing powerful Yimo experts and was credited with sealing three Yimo Kings in succession.

However, the prolonged war left both the Ancestral Stone and its spirit, Yan, catastrophically damaged. Most of the artifact's original abilities became dormant, while Yan fell into a deep slumber. The Great Desolation Tablet later remarked that the Ancestral Stone had suffered even more severe damage than itself.

Following the end of the Ancient War, the Ancestral Stone eventually came to rest within the Hidden Cave near Qingyang Town. Hidden inside a narrow crevice above the Rock Pool, it continuously released tiny droplets of Red Liquid into the spring below, gradually transforming it into a valuable cultivation resource over countless years.

The artifact remained undiscovered until it was eventually found by Lin Dong. By that time, most of its original abilities had already become dormant because of the severe damage it had sustained during the Ancient War.

artifacts.trivia:
The Ancestral Stone was introduced simply as the "Stone Talisman" for more than 780 novel chapters before its true identity was revealed.

Tiny droplets of Red Liquid continuously dripped from the Ancestral Stone into the Rock Pool for countless years before it was discovered by Lin Dong.

Yan remained dormant for much of the early story because both he and the Ancestral Stone were severely damaged during the Ancient War.

The first two abilities revealed by the Stone Talisman were the production of Red Liquid and access to the Spiritual Domain.

Before its true identity was revealed, the artifact was simply referred to as the "Stone Talisman" by both Lin Dong and nearly every other character.

artifacts.introText: Darkness Saint Scythe (AKA Sacred Darkness Sickle) is an Ancient Divine Item. It is ranked fifth on the Ancient Divine Item List.
artifacts.history:
This divine object took serious damage during the Great World War and the Scythe Spirit was destroyed. Finally, it landed in the hands of the first palace master of our Darkness Palace.

As of now, the current Scythe Spirit should have been forged after the second owner of the Darkness Ancestral Symbol sacrificed his body. Nevertheless, given his strength, it was clear that he was not powerful enough to recreate the Scythe Spirit. Therefore, he merged with them and repaired it, before he was finally able to create a new Scythe Spirit.

artifacts.introText: The Heavenly Crocodile Bone Spear is a Destiny Soul Treasure. It was created by the Ancient Heavenly Crocodile himself. It is made from the bones of the Ancient Heavenly Crocodile. The seemingly light and graceful bone spear actually weighed no less than a ten thousand catty boulder. There were fine blood streaks spreading out from the handle of the bone spear. These blood streaks covered almost the entire body of the spear, making it look like blood vessels. Furthermore, these blood vessels appeared to be slowly pulsating while the faint smell of a vast ancient wasteland gradually spread out. This further bolstered the spear’s austere aura. It was created from the hardest part within the heavenly crocodile’s body. The Bone Spear has been imbued with some remnants of the Heavenly Crocodile’s Demon Spirit when it faded from the world.

artifacts.introText: Moyun Blade / 摩云刃 is a low-grade Soul Treasure. It was originally possessed by members of the Black Python Mountain faction, including Han Zong and Han Sheng. This item is characterized by its stealth-oriented attack properties.
artifacts.appearance:
It appears as a dark yellow, serrated miniature dagger and can be controlled via mental power to silently penetrate defenses.

The weapon takes the form of a dark yellow, serrated dagger roughly the size of a thumb, with its surface covered in fine teeth. During nighttime combat, it can completely conceal its trajectory, making it difficult for even Yuan Dan–realm experts to detect through conventional perception. Its body can be hidden in the wielder’s sleeve or concealed underground, and when launched in a surprise attack, it produces only faint energy fluctuations
artifacts.personality:
During the conflict between the Thousand Gold Association and Black Python Mountain, Han Zong took advantage of Xia Wanjin’s weakened state after detonating his golden copper coins, and remotely controlled the Moyun Blade to carry out a fatal sneak attack. The weapon pierced Xia Wanjin’s chest, shattering his heart and directly causing the death of this Yuan Dan–realm expert.

While fighting Han Zong in Yan City, Lin Dong used his mental perception to lock onto the Moyun Blade concealed underground. By creating a yuan power vortex with an ancient halberd, he captured the weapon, forcibly erased Han Zong’s mental imprint, and stored it in his Qian Kun Bag.

After acquiring the Moyun Blade, Lin Dong later used it in his duel against Yue Shan of the Blood Wolf Gang, piercing through the opponent’s defenses and delivering the fatal blow.== References ==

artifacts.title: Stone Talisman
artifacts.introText: Stone Talisman, later revealed to be the Ancestral Stone (祖石), is an ancient divine artifact created by the Symbol Ancestor during the Ancient War against the Yimo. Hidden within the Hidden Cave above the Rock Pool for countless years, it was eventually discovered by Lin Dong, becoming the cornerstone of his cultivation journey.
artifacts.appearance:
When first discovered, the Stone Talisman appeared as a small ash-gray stone artifact approximately two fingers wide. Its surface was covered with mysterious ancient symbols resembling cryptic characters.

The artifact was embedded within a perfectly preserved palm imprint hidden inside a narrow crevice near the ceiling of the Hidden Cave. Despite the passage of countless years, the palm imprint remained exceptionally clear, suggesting that an unimaginably powerful individual had placed the artifact there.

Before its true identity was revealed, the Stone Talisman occasionally emitted a faint glow while continuously absorbing moonlight from its surroundings.

As the Ancestral Stone gradually recovered its power, more of its ancient runes became visible whenever it was activated. Following Yan's gradual awakening, more of the artifact's true nature and abilities were revealed.
artifacts.personality:
During the Ancient War, the Symbol Ancestor created the Ancestral Stone to aid in the war against the Yimo and to maintain the balance among the Eight Ancestral Symbols.

Throughout the conflict, he wielded the artifact alongside the Eight Ancestral Symbols. The Ancestral Stone played a vital role in suppressing powerful Yimo experts and was credited with sealing three Yimo Kings in succession.

However, the prolonged war left both the Ancestral Stone and its spirit, Yan, catastrophically damaged. Most of the artifact's original abilities became dormant, while Yan fell into a deep slumber. The Great Desolation Tablet later remarked that the Ancestral Stone had suffered even more severe damage than itself.

Following the end of the Ancient War, the Ancestral Stone eventually came to rest within the Hidden Cave near Qingyang Town. Hidden inside a narrow crevice above the Rock Pool, it continuously released tiny droplets of Red Liquid into the spring below, gradually transforming it into a valuable cultivation resource over countless years.

The artifact remained undiscovered until it was eventually found by Lin Dong. By that time, most of its original abilities had already become dormant because of the severe damage it had sustained during the Ancient War.

artifacts.trivia:
The Ancestral Stone was introduced simply as the "Stone Talisman" for more than 780 novel chapters before its true identity was revealed.

Tiny droplets of Red Liquid continuously dripped from the Ancestral Stone into the Rock Pool for countless years before it was discovered by Lin Dong.

Yan remained dormant for much of the early story because both he and the Ancestral Stone were severely damaged during the Ancient War.

The first two abilities revealed by the Stone Talisman were the production of Red Liquid and access to the Spiritual Domain.

Before its true identity was revealed, the artifact was simply referred to as the "Stone Talisman" by both Lin Dong and nearly every other character.

One of the three heads in the Yuan Gate was alarmed and he had to personally suppress that ruthless person. That person was Zhou Tong, who mastered the Great Desolation Scripture and was the disciple of Ying Xuanzi. His death from that incident is also one of the reasons why Dao Sect has a grudge against Yuan Gate. They wanted to declare all out war against Yuan Gate that time but their sect master stopped them.

clans.history:
The Great Desolate Sect was attacked by the Yimo in the far past, and a great earth shattering battle had occurred here. In the end, the sect was destroyed, but the Yimo also suffered substantial losses, resulting in the existence of Demonic Qi deep within the land. Over the past few years, this Demonic Qi has gradually emerged.

The remnant wills of numerous Great Desolate Sect elders were left within the Great Wastelands Ancient Tablet. Over the years, the protector gradually absorbed these wills, causing some changes to occur. These changes were initially positive, but as Demonic Qi gushed out from the land, the protector was gradually invaded by it. However, his tenacity and willpower is matchless. Thus, even after being corroded by this Demonic Qi, he refused to hurt anything within the Great Desolate Sect and could only howl miserably everyday.

clans.introText: Yuan Gate is one of the 8 great Super Sects of the East Xuan Continent. They are also the strongest sect amongst them. The three big headmaster are Samsara Stage powerhouses. The elder are at Advanced Profound Life Stage.
clans.history:
One hundred years ago, an exceptionally ruthless individual from the Dao Sect went bonkers and rushed into the Yuan Gate and killed three of their elders, shocking the entire Eastern Xuan Region. One of the three heads in the Yuan Gate was alarmed and he had to personally suppress that ruthless person.

As it stands, the last three winners of the Hundred Empire War have become a member of Yuan Gate, and are now famed practitioners across the entire Eastern Xuan Region.

Yuan Gate and the Celestial Demon Marten Clan are mortal enemies with each having killed each other's practitioners.
